values.note: Rocky Ridge on the booking site: A Loop 10 electric (incl. 1 ADA), B Loop 16 electric (incl. 1 ADA), D Loop 26 electric, C Loop 46 basic, E Loop 41 basic plus 4 tent sites. Maximum vehicle lengths 25-115 ft (B Loop 70-115, mostly pull-through); a few sites take only 25 ft.

sites.source: https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/eleven-mile-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50024 per-site catalog (loop, type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), audit/state_park_fees/co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl, re-read for A Loop 2026-10-27

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and laundry open May 1 (laundry May 5) to Labor Day; water (hand and pressurized pumps) May 1 to Sept 30; vault toilets year-round; dump station Memorial weekend to Labor Day, by request at the office in winter. The park office is in the camper services building near Rocky Ridge.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park/eleven-mile-state-park-camping-lodging ('Laundry facilities (Open May 5 through Labor Day ...)', 'Dump station (Open Memorial Weekend to Labor Day ...)', 'Shower and flush toilets (Open May 1 until Labor Day ...)', 'Water fill-up station/Hand pumps and pressurized water pumps (Open May 1 to September 30 ...)', 'Vault Toilets (Open year-round)') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park ('The Eleven Mile Park Office is located in the camper services building near Rocky Ridge Campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Open for winter camping with limited services: Rocky Ridge Loops C through E close for the season November 1, leaving the A and B electric loops.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park/eleven-mile-state-park-camping-lodging ('Eleven Mile is open for winter camping, but not all campsites are available during the winter months'; 'Campgrounds closing for the season November 1 ... Rocky Ridge Loops C through E'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed too. Maximum 14 days in any 28-day period. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/eleven-mile-state-park/eleven-mile-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Eleven Mile State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

note: The only electric campground at Eleven Mile Reservoir (~8,600 ft). Loops sit among trees and rocky outcrops atop a ridge above the reservoir; many sites (incl. the exposed electric loops A/B/D) have open reservoir views, ~5-min walk down to shore - lakeview, not on a beach. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 30-amp electric (A/B/D), $28 basic / $36 electric (stored fees, CPW page), reservation-only on cpwshop with a 6-month window (now on the entry), and year-round operation (winter: C-E loops close Nov 1, A/B stay). Sites corrected 144 -> 143 (52 electric, 87 basic, 4 tent) with lengths to 115 ft and pull-throughs; added laundry, vault toilets, potable water with their seasons, 14-in-28-day max. Pin is 158 m from the A Loop and 539 m from the centroid of all Rocky Ridge sites (cpwshop points check out on imagery), inside the campground's spread. Note trimmed of field facts and the RV Life line. No missing drive-in campground: the park's nine campgrounds are Rocky Ridge, North Shore, Stoll Mountain, Cross Creek, Witcher's Cove, Lazy Boy, Howbert Point, Rocking Chair (all in the DB) and the walk-in backcountry sites.
